svg.title: Andres Torres, Senior Full Stack Software Engineer: pixel-art CV
svg.desc: Pixel-art banner: a purple space octopus with green eyes floating next to a small spiral galaxy. Andres Torres, Senior Full Stack Software Engineer. Frontend, backend, AI agents and cloud. I've worked with AI from three sides: studying it, grading it and shipping it. M.Sc. in AI, LLM code evaluation at Scale AI, AI agents in healthcare. As solutions architect, my design requirements are performance, cost and compliance, owning the full lifecycle from requirements and API design through frontend and backend development and deployment on AWS. Tomorrow Health, Software Developer · Via Howdy, 2025-NOW: solutions architect & tech lead · apis, aws, ai agents. Fullstack Labs, Software Engineer · Led Backend Modernization, 2023-2025: gcp → aws · -$15-20k per month · coverage 40% → 80%+. Scale Ai, AI Trainer & Code Evaluator · Contract, 2023-2024: llm code evaluation for rlhf. Condor Labs, Senior Software Developer, 2021-2023: medical-license apis · acting team lead. Bogota Mayor'S Office, Full Stack Developer, 2020-2021: citizen-service platforms · gabo app. Luxity Labs, Full Stack Developer, 2019-2020: web + mobile apps. Incubapp, Full Stack Developer & Tech Lead, 2018-2019: led takeone, a serverless scheduler. Three pixel-art galaxies orbiting each other, with the Claude, ChatGPT and Cursor logos at their cores. Architecture: Solution Architecture · System Design · Tech Lead. Languages: Python · Typescript · Go · Java · Sql. Ai: Langgraph · Langchain · Mcp · Rag · Pgvector. Llms: Claude · Openai · Aws Bedrock · Openrouter. Backend: Fastapi · Django · Node.Js · Spring Boot. Frontend: React · Angular · React Native · Ionic. Cloud: Aws · Gcp · Terraform · Docker · Kubernetes. Data: Postgresql · Redis · Kafka · Mongodb. Observe: Langfuse · Datadog · Grafana · Cloudwatch. M.Sc. in Artificial Intelligence, Universidad de los Andes, 2024-2026. B.S. Computer and Systems Engineering, UPTC, 2015-2021, with an exchange semester at BUAP, Mexico, on an academic scholarship. Certifications: Aws Certified AI Practitioner, Google Cloud Associate Cloud Engineer, Jsnad · Openjs Node.Js App Developer, Ibm Machine Learning With Python.
